  • Humans have a need to communicate -> to transfer an idea or concept from one mind to another mind
  • These concepts cannot be directly transfered, so we use a medium -> language
  • Communication is broken if the concept that received (~"interpreted") by one is not the same concept sent by the other -> the dictionary of symbols used by one to translate from the mind-idea must match the dictionary of symbols used by the other to translate back into a mind-idea

This basic gist can be extended (i.e. some communication takes place across time -> the symbol dictionary should remain constant through time), but this is the general overview. To modify symbols (the definitions attached to words) truly is to break communication, Babbel style.
